panels.title: Scrape targets up
panels.description: Hosts whose /metrics endpoint was scraped successfully.

targets.expr: sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_email_handler_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_email_handler_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p95 email handler time
panels.description: Histogram buckets stop at 10s, so values above 10s are clamped.

panels.title: Running versions
panels.description: Service versions seen emitting ServiceVersion events over the selected range.

targets.expr: count by (service, version, instance) (increase(simplelogin_custom_event_serviceversion_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) > 0)

panels.title: Avg email handler time per host

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_email_handler_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_email_handler_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Email handler time percentiles
panels.description: Default histogram buckets (5ms..10s): anything above 10s reads as 10s.

panels.title: Avg SMTP connection time per host

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_connection_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_connection_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Avg SMTP sending time per host

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_sending_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_sending_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Avg SMTP servers tried per send
panels.description: >1 means the first postfix relay failed and a fallback was used.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_servers_tried_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_servers_tried_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_nb_rcpt_tos_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_nb_rcpt_tos_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_reverse_alias_replacement_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_reverse_alias_replacement_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

60 * sum by (dmarc, header) (rate(simplelogin_custom_event_spamdcheck_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*", dmarc=~"reject|quarantine|soft_fail"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_pgp_encrypt_rust_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_pgp_encrypt_rust_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_pgp_sign_rust_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_pgp_sign_rust_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_pgp_encrypt_fallback_rust_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_pgp_encrypt_fallback_rust_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-app.*", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-app.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-app.*", code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-app.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-partner-api.*", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-partner-api.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-partner-api.*", code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-partner-api.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Aliases & contacts created via partner API /s
Events stored to DB /s by type
Events sent to partner /min by HTTP code

targets.expr: sum by (container) (rate(simplelogin_custom_sync_event_process_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (container) (rate(simplelogin_custom_sync_event_process_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Sync event end-to-end lag (elapsed since creation)
panels.description: Buckets stop at 10s: a growing backlog shows as a flat 10s p95, use the avg for the real value.

targets.expr: sum by (container) (rate(simplelogin_custom_sync_event_elapsed_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (container) (rate(simplelogin_custom_sync_event_elapsed_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Dead letter events to process (avg batch)

targets.expr: sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_dead_letter_events_to_process_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-dead-letter.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum (rate(simplelogin_custom_dead_letter_events_to_process_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-dead-letter.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Server connections by host, database & role
panels.description: Per host, database and role. sv_idle_xact is a subset of sv_active.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_sv_active{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})
sum by (instance, database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_sv_idle{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})
sum by (instance, database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_sv_idle_xact{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})

panels.title: Open server connections by database & role
panels.description: Server connections pgdog holds open to each Postgres database and role (primary/replica), summed over the selected hosts. open = sv_active + sv_idle (sv_idle_xact is a subset of sv_active). Dashed line: the sum of the pools' max_connections, i.e. the most connections pgdog can open to that database/role.

targets.expr: sum by (database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_sv_active{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})
sum by (database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_sv_idle{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})
sum by (database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_sv_idle_xact{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})
sum by (database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_max_connections{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})

panels.title: Pool usage % by database & role (worst host)
panels.description: Per database and role, the highest pool usage across the selected hosts. open = (sv_active + sv_idle) / max_connections; active = sv_active / max_connections. When open sits at 100%, the pool cannot grow and new transactions queue (see waiting clients).

targets.expr: max by (database, role) ((simplelogin_pgdog_sv_active{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"} + simplelogin_pgdog_sv_idle{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"}) / simplelogin_pgdog_max_connections{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})

max by (database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_sv_active{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"} / simplelogin_pgdog_max_connections{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})

panels.title: Waiting clients & max wait by database & role
panels.description: Clients queued for a server connection (cl_waiting, summed over hosts) and the longest wait (maxwait, worst host, right axis) per database and role.

targets.expr: sum by (database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_cl_waiting{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})
max by (database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_maxwait{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})

panels.title: Queries & transactions /s by database & role
panels.description: Queries and transactions per second routed to each database and role, summed over the selected hosts.

targets.expr: sum by (database, role) (rate(simplelogin_pgdog_total_query_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (database, role) (rate(simplelogin_pgdog_total_xact_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Avg query & wait time by database & role (worst host)
panels.description: pgdog avg_query_time and avg_wait_time (ms), highest value across the selected hosts.

targets.expr: max by (database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_avg_query_time{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})
max by (database, role) (simplelogin_pgdog_avg_wait_time{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"})

panels.title: Server errors & checkout timeouts /min by database & role

targets.expr: 60 * sum by (database, role) (rate(simplelogin_pgdog_total_server_errors{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"}[$__rate_interval]))

60 * sum by (database, role) (rate(simplelogin_pgdog_total_checkout_timeouts{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog", database=~"$pg_database", role=~"$pg_role"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Sum of CPU seconds/s across the python processes of each container group (1 = one full core).
